name: 4orm-iq
description: 4orm - Know Before You Send. Verification control centre.

scripts.check: node tools/compliance.mjs && node tools/compliance-test.mjs && node tools/scanner.mjs && npm test
scripts.test: node tools/verify.mjs && node tools/graph-tests.mjs && for f in tools/smoke*.mjs tools/frames.mjs tools/smallscreen.mjs tools/handover.mjs tools/spacecheck.mjs tools/protocheck.mjs tools/waitstable.mjs tools/pathcheck.mjs tools/opscheck.mjs tools/docscheck.mjs tools/uxgate.mjs tools/budgetcheck.mjs tools/spendcheck.mjs tools/shapecheck.mjs tools/sqlcheck.mjs tools/fencecheck.mjs tools/schedcheck.mjs tools/doorcheck.mjs tools/nextcheck.mjs tools/termscheck.mjs; do echo "-- $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
